N1 Model Architecture

  1. 5 input neurons
  2. Hidden 1: 200
  3. Hidden 2: 100
  4. Hidden 3: 50
  5. Hidden 4: 30
  6. Hidden 5: 25
  7. Hidden 6: 10

N1 Loss function

||[ L_c(t, N1(x)) = \left(\frac{m\sigma}{A\rho N1(x)}\log\left(1 + \sigma\frac{A\rho N1(x)}{m}(v_0 - w)t\right) + wt + r_0 - 1\right)^2 ||]kde ||[ \sigma = \frac{v_0 - w}{\sqrt{(v_0 - w)^2 + \delta}} ||]kde ||(\delta||) je mala kladna hodnota, v nasom pripade ||(\delta = 1\times10^{-6}||).

Drag_distance_au function

vypocitava ||[ r(t, N1(x)) = \frac{m\sigma}{A\rho N1(x)}\log\left(1 + \sigma\frac{A\rho N1(x)}{m}(v_0 - w)t\right) + wt + r_0 ||]

L_c function

hlavna loss funkcia, vypocitava ||[ L_c(t, N1(x)) = (r(t, N1(x)) - 1)^2 ||]teda porovnavame ||(r(t, N1(x))||) oproti jednotke, teda cely vysledok drag-based modelu musi byt vynormovana vzdialenostou 1AU, kedze vsetko co pocitame v rovnici je v nejakej forme kilometrov:
  • ||(\omega||) - ||(km/s||)
  • ||(\rho||) - ||(g/km^3||)
  • ||(A||) - ||(km^2||)
  • ||(v_0||) - ||(km/s||)
